text:
A thin converging lens is used to produce, on a screen, a focused image of a candle.
screen
image
lens
candle
The screen and the lens are moved back and forth and various focused images are produced on
the screen.
Which statement is always true?
A
The image is at the principal focus (focal point) of the lens.
B
The image is bigger than the object.
C
The image is closer to the lens than the object is.
D
The image is inverted.

options.label: A
options.text: The image is at the principal focus (focal point) of the lens.

options.label: B
options.text: The image is bigger than the object.

options.label: C
options.text: The image is closer to the lens than the object is.
